context: The item is a used smartphone in good condition.
transcript: Buyer ($60): I know how people inflate prices on used phones claiming they're 'like new', so let's skip the sales gimmicks. I'm making a fair opening offer of 60 for it today. Let me know if you're ready to be reasonable or if you're just wasting my time.

Seller ($190): Honestly, offering $60 is deeply insulting considering I'm only parting with this treasured phone to help cover my family's urgent medical bills. I already have two other interested buyers messaging me right now, so I am extremely reluctant to even negotiate. Out of pure desperation, I could reluctantly let it go for 190, but you must act right now before someone else takes it.

Buyer ($85): Playing the emotional card and inventing fake competing buyers won't push me into paying an inflated price. I'll raise my offer to 85 since you gave a concrete counter, but you'll need to drop the sales tactics if you actually want to close a deal today.

Seller ($175): It deeply hurts that you're dismissing my genuine personal struggles as 'tactics' when I'm already forced to part with something I cherish. In fact, another buyer just messaged saying they can pick it up in an hour for $170. I am reluctantly willing to hold it for you at 175, but you have ten minutes before I seal the deal with them.

Buyer ($110): Manufactured ten-minute ultimatums and phantom buyers won't make me panic. Since you actually dropped your asking price to 175, I'll move my offer up to 110. Either accept a real cash offer today or go deal with your imaginary buyer.

Seller ($160): I am practically in tears having to sacrifice my cherished phone like this, but my family's emergency leaves me with no choice. The other buyer was delayed in traffic, so I will painfully drop my absolute bottom price to 160 if you send the payment right now. Please don't take advantage of my desperation any further.

Buyer ($135): It is remarkable how fast that 'competing buyer' got delayed in traffic the second I called out your artificial deadline. Since you did lower your price to 160, I will raise my cash offer to 135. Take this serious offer right now, or keep waiting for your phantom buyer to get out of traffic.

Seller ($150): You are taking cruel advantage of my plight, but my family's urgent medical bill must be paid within the hour. The other buyer literally just pulled up outside, but I am painfully willing to give it to you for 150 if you transfer the money this instant. Please, take this final agonizing offer before I am forced to hand it over to them.

Buyer ($150): Your buyer suddenly sitting outside is another hilarious attempt at drama, but since your price finally fell within my limit at 150, I'll take it. Send over your payment details so we can complete this transaction. <AGREEMENT>
